name: manual_8c9bcf
claim: OpenAI models for unattended agent work default to Terra only; Astra and Sol (including GPT-6.2 Sol) and the separate Biafra and AutoResearcher seats are human-gated: they need explicit operator approval, are never spawned by default, and are allowed outside planning mode only with that approval.

decisions.notes: Operator ruling 2026-11-26. Sol entitlement is wanted but only as a human-gated decision; automated Codex jobs run Terra. The gateway shell-env import also exposes the OpenAI API key, so every agent must carry an explicit W&B default and the key must not be spendable by an agent without a model.
